clause: QR codes + reusable object libraries/snippets + frame stroke options [STU-LAY-034]

scope.summary: Implement QR codes as editable vector objects of type Web Hyperlink, Plain Text, Text Message, Email, or Contact Card, with color choice and post-generation editing (per-record QR generation is a data-merge capability, MT-189). Implement reusable object libraries and snippets: store, search, sort, and re-place objects (with per-item type/description metadata) and drag-out/export selections that re-place at original or cursor position. Implement frame stroke options (weight, cap, join, miter, align inside/center/outside, dash/dotted/stripe stroke types, custom savable stroke styles, arrowheads with scale, gap color/tint) applied through the shared vector stroke model (14.5, never forked).
acceptance_criteria: editable QR of all five types; object library store/search/sort/re-place; frame strokes via shared vector model
proof_targets: QR generation runtime; library re-place + shared-stroke test
expected_tests: live: QR generates as editable vector object of each type with color + post-edit
test: object library store/search/sort/re-place at original/cursor; frame stroke options via shared 14.5 stroke model

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / QR codes, object libraries & frame strokes

risk_if_missed: No QR, reusable snippets, or frame strokes; or a forked stroke model (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
